newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekran to retain control of Bakun dam.
newsitem.headline: Ekran to retain control of Bakun dam.

text.p: Malaysia's Ekran Bhd said on Wednesday it will retain control of the Bakun hydroelectric project as its biggest shareholder.
It said in a statement that that Ekran will retain a 32 percent stake in the $5.5 billion project to be built in Malaysia's Sarawak state on the island of Borneo.
It said the stake would make Ekran the biggest shareholder of Bakun Hydroelectric Corp Bhd.

"In compensation of Ekran's past efforts and future role as project managers over the construction period of six years, Ekran will receive a total sum of approximately one billion ringgit," Ekran said in the statement.

The statement was issued just ahead of Bakun's signing of the dam's engineering contract with a consortium led by ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG and Brazil's Companhia Braseileira de Projectos e Obras (CBPO).
The statement said Ekran would also retain administrative control of the project through the construction period.
"Ekran will continue to lead as it had hitherto, by having complete administrative and management control as the sole and exclusive project managers," the statement said.
Construction is expected to begin early in 1997, and the 2,400 megawatt project completed by 2002.
